'''Itsukushima Shrine''' (厳島神社, 嚴島神社, いつくしまじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|en|Shinto shrine|qid=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrine}}
named after "Itsukushima" and enshrines {{ill|Ichikishima-hime|ja|市杵島姫神}} as its primary deity.

There are approximately 500 shrines across Japan with this name, with the main shrine being {{ill|Itsukushima Shrine|en|Itsukushima Shrine|qid=Q191763|lt=Itsukushima Shrine}} in [[Hatsukaichi City]], {{ill|Hiroshima Prefecture|en|Hiroshima Prefecture|qid=Q617375|lt=Hiroshima Prefecture}}.
== Main Shrine ==
* '''{{ill|Itsukushima Shrine|en|Itsukushima Shrine|qid=Q191763|lt=Itsukushima Shrine}}''' (Hatsukaichi City, Hiroshima Prefecture)
